title: C2 Milestone 11
completion_message: ¡Magistral! Has superado el Milestone 11. Manejas la diplomacia conflictiva, dominas el vocabulario de fusiones corporativas, ciberseguridad y usas las preposiciones como un nativo erudito. Estás en la élite del idioma.

parts.visual:
Este Milestone evalúa tu maestría en las lecciones recientes: 

1. Advanced Relatives: 
- The client TO WHOM I spoke. 
- The meeting DURING WHICH he resigned. 
- The extent TO WHICH this is true. 
- All of WHOM / None of WHICH. 

2. Mergers & Acquisitions: 
- Synergy (1+1=3). 
- Takeover bid & Spin-off. 
- Antitrust laws. 
- Golden parachute & Due diligence.
parts.audio: Welcome to Milestone 11, Boardroom Elite. This exam tests your mastery of the latest high-level topics. First, Advanced Relatives. Moving prepositions before pronouns: The client TO WHOM I spoke. The meeting DURING WHICH he resigned. And phrases like 'The extent TO WHICH'. Second, Mergers and Acquisitions. Understanding terms like Synergy, Takeover bid, Spin-off, Antitrust laws, Golden parachute, and Due diligence.

parts.visual:
3. Data Privacy & Security: 
- Data breach (Filtración). 
- GDPR & Opt-in/Opt-out. 
- Phishing & Ransomware. 
- NDA & Encryption. 

4. Diplomatic Disagreement: 
- With all due respect... 
- I beg to differ. 
- Let's agree to disagree. 
- Pushback & Playing devil's advocate. 
- Let's take this offline.
parts.audio: Third, Data Privacy and Security. Knowing the risks of a Data breach, Phishing, and Ransomware. Understanding GDPR, Opt-in, Encryption, and NDAs. Finally, Diplomatic Disagreement. Pushing back politely with phrases like 'With all due respect', 'I beg to differ', and 'Let's agree to disagree'. Knowing when to play devil's advocate or take a topic offline. Good luck on the exam!

stages.title: The Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Demuestra tu dominio legal, tecnológico y diplomático en este examen.

questions.question: Colloquial: The manager who I reported to. -> Formal: The manager ____ I reported.
The two companies believe that by merging, they can create massive ____, reducing costs by 20%. (Sinergias).
Hackers locked all our servers and are demanding 10 Bitcoin. We have been hit by ____.
You think the marketing campaign was a success, but looking at the sales data, I ____ to differ. (Me permito discrepar).
We interviewed 50 candidates, none of ____ had the required C2 English certificate.
Before signing the acquisition contract, our lawyers must perform a month of due ____. (Auditoría previa).
We suffered a massive data ____, and 2 million passwords were leaked to the public. (Brecha/Filtración).
Just to play ____'s advocate, what if the European market rejects our product completely?
Colloquial: The problem that we are dealing with. -> Formal: The problem ____ we are dealing.
If the board fires the CEO, they will have to pay him a $30 million golden ____. (Indemnización millonaria).
According to ____, European users must explicitly opt-in to receive marketing emails.
We are not making any progress in this argument. Let's agree to ____ and move to the next topic.
We still don't know the extent ____ the network was compromised. (Hasta qué punto).
The government blocked the merger using ____ laws because it would create a monopoly.
An employee received a fake email from 'IT Support' asking for his password. It was a ____ attack.
If you announce that we are cutting salaries, expect a lot of ____ from the union. (Rechazo/Resistencia).
They made a hostile takeover ____ to buy 51% of the company's shares. (Oferta pública).
To keep the messages secret, the app uses end-to-end ____. (Cifrado).
This discussion is getting too detailed for this meeting. Let's take this ____. (Discutirlo en privado luego).
Before I reveal the secret algorithm, you must sign this ____. (Acuerdo de confidencialidad).
The man to ____ I spoke. (A quien)
The extent to ____ this is true. (La medida en la cual)
Create massive ____. (Sinergias con S)
Due ____. (Auditoría previa con D)
A data ____. (Brecha/filtración con B)
Locked by ____. (Virus de rescate con R)
I ____ to differ. (Me permito discrepar con B)
Play ____'s advocate. (Abogado del diablo con D)
Expect a lot of ____. (Resistencia/Rechazo con P)
Take this ____. (Discutir fuera de reunión con O)
